descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解法睿产品的收费方式和[价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/billing-for-tongyi-farui-1)。
- 该接口需要开通法睿商品相关的后付费服务（开通免费），可以使用该账号的AccessKey和AccessSecret来调用我们的OpenApi服务
- 服务的响应结果是以流式的形式来返回（SSE）。
- 接口的调用需要阿里云百炼平台的工作空间权限。
descriptions.en:
Before you use this API, understand the billing methods and [pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/user-guide/billing-for-tongyi-farui-1) for the Tongyi Farui product.

- To use this API, you must activate the pay-as-you-go service for the Tongyi Farui product. Activation is free. Use the AccessKey and AccessSecret of your account to call the OpenAPI service.

- The service response is returned as a stream in the Server-Sent Events (SSE) format.

- To call this API, you must have workspace permissions in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
